thread:
Nina López: Heads up - daily reconcile shows marketplace-reported metered units for Azure Marketplace are ~18% lower than our internal ingestion for the same customers. Spike started.
Samir Gupta: That's a pretty specific delta. Any pattern by SKU or dimension?
AzureMarketplaceBot: ingest_batch(2026-03-15): WARN - missing dimension 'compute_units' for some usage rows; defaulted to 'units'.
Carlos Rivera: Looked at a sample of 50 customers. The partner is sending metric name 'units' but our mapper expects 'compute_units' and converts to core-minutes. For those rows we applied a 1:1 mapping instead of scale factor 1 compute_unit = 1.35 core-minutes. So reported quantity was lower.
Danni Park: Oof. So it's a mapping config issue in the marketplace adapter. Do we have a list of impacted SKUs?
Samir Gupta: Quick query I ran on staging to find mismatches:
```
SELECT customer_id, sku, SUM(our_qty) as our_total, SUM(mp_qty) as mp_total, (SUM(our_qty)-SUM(mp_qty))/NULLIF(SUM(our_qty),0) as pct_diff
FROM metered_usage_join
WHERE date >= '2026-03-14' AND marketplace = 'azure'
GROUP BY customer_id, sku
HAVING pct_diff > 0.1;
```
Nina López: Results: 126 customers, 9 SKUs concentrated on gpu* and llm-infer.* series. Average pct_diff 17.8%.
FinanceBot: alert: marketplace.usage_reporting.delta > 10% triggered. Created ticket FIN-7892.
Carlos Rivera: Root cause: partner schema change last week renamed dimension to 'units' and dropped 'unit_scale'. Our adapter looked for unit_scale and defaulted to 1. We need to support backward-compatible mapping and a safe-remap path.
Danni Park: Short-term remediation options?
Samir Gupta: 1) Apply delta credits for affected invoices this billing period (requires finance approval). 2) Re-ingest the raw marketplace file and re-run consumption mapping with a corrected mapping table. 3) Ask partner to re-emit with explicit unit_scale.
Nina López: Preference is re-ingest + remap so ledger + usage history match exactly. Credits are messy. But re-ingest needs coordination so we don't double-count.
Carlos Rivera: For safe re-ingest plan: - create staging remap table mapping(metric_name -> {unit_scale}) - run remap dry-run producing candidate deltas - diff deltas vs invoices - if approved, reapply to ledger with idempotent transaction ids prefixed mp_reingest_20260315
Samir Gupta: Add a reconciliation sanity check: for each customer compute before/after usage and require delta agreement within 0.5%. Also tag rows with marketplace_file_hash to avoid duplicate ingestion.
FinanceBot: FINANCE: Adding required approval checklist: business owner sign-off, legal confirmation if credits > $5k, audit trail retention 90 days.
Danni Park: I'll spin up the remap job in staging and drop a sample CSV. ETA 2 hours.
Nina López: Please include the raw marketplace CSVs and our mapped CSV side-by-side. Use the sample customers from Samir's query.
Carlos Rivera: I'll prepare the SQL and a script to generate idempotency keys: CONCAT('mp_reingest_', marketplace_file_hash, '_', row_id). That should prevent duplicate entitlement/usage applies.
Samir Gupta: Also add a monitor that fails the pipeline when unit_scale is missing for a known sku pattern. No silent defaults.
AzureMarketplaceBot: partner_notification queued: message sent to partner-ops@azuremarketplace with ticket AM-4561 requesting re-emission and unit_scale clarification.
Nina López: Great. Next steps: (1) Danni run staging remap and share sample CSVs, (2) Carlos create idempotency script + SQL, (3) Samir add hard-fail monitor and adjust dashboard, (4) Finance review FIN-7892 and sign off on credits only if re-ingest impossible.
Danni Park: Staging run started. Posting link to artifacts when done.
Samir Gupta: If partner can't re-emit quickly we proceed with re-ingest + backfill and notify customers about potential invoice adjustments. Keep comms light and factual.
FinanceBot: FINANCE: ticket FIN-7892 updated: awaiting remap artifact. Notifying billing-ops.
Nina López: Thanks everyone. Will follow up after the staging artifact review. :raised_hands:
